design: v002 to R04. Two-post timber paifang: cloud-carved clamp stones bound in iron, near-round posts with one outward raking strut each, through-tenoned tie beam with wedges and two pairs of drying herb bundles, wide jade plaque with emblem and cloud reliefs between studs, que-ti brackets, dou-gong row, concave grey-teal tiled roof with flying corners, barrel tiles, hip ridges, ridge scrolls and a jade pearl on a lotus base; jade banners from poles past the lintel ends, paper lantern, wicker herb basket. Clear opening 2.22 m at the ground.
